      description cells now translate as prose (authored into hu.api.json).
    
    - Drift: add scripts/check-locale-drift.ts — it derives the content-hash keys the

2	name: docs-i18n
3	description: "How docs/ i18n works — locale layer in i18n.ts, adapter split (guides=claude-code, API=glossary), and the VitePress i18nRouting audit conclusion"
4	metadata: 
5	  node_type: memory
6	  type: project

8	---
9	
10	The VitePress docs site (`docs/`, `@pantoken/docs`) has two locales: `root` (English, `/…`) and
11	`hu` (Magyar, `/hu/…`), a symmetric prefix swap including `/api/` ↔ `/hu/api/`.
12	
13	**Translation layer = `docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts`.** `LOCALES[locale]` (`LocaleMeta`) holds ALL
14	localizable UI strings: nav/sidebar labels, `editText`, plus (added Jul 2026) `themeSelector`
15	(the custom palette selector's button + palette labels — `Canvas` stays as-is per brand rules),
16	`chrome` (VitePress default-theme labels: outline, docFooter, dark/light switch, sidebarMenu,
17	returnToTop, langMenu, lastUpdated, notFound), and `search` (local-search UI). `config.ts` expands
18	these into per-locale `themeConfig` (VitePress deep-merges it recursively over the global
19	themeConfig via `stackView`, so per-locale `outline.label` keeps the global `outline.level`).
20	Search translations are the exception — they live in the GLOBAL `themeConfig.search.options.locales`
21	keyed by locale index, because the local-search index reads the root themeConfig. `ThemeSelector.vue`
22	reads its strings at runtime via `useData().theme.value.themeSelector` (falls back to
23	`THEME_SELECTOR_DEFAULTS` in theme.ts). When English UI is added, port it here, not inline.
24	
25	**Adapter split.** Guides (`docs/scripts/translate-guides.ts`, hand-written prose) use the
26	`claude-code` adapter (`docs:guides:locales:claude`) for real translation. The generated API tree
27	(`docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts`, TypeDoc + CSS reference) uses the default `glossary` adapter
28	(`docs:api:locales`) — deterministic term-swap, well-suited to structural reference content
29	(headings like Parameters/Returns/Példák; identifiers and code stay as-is). Don't run `:claude` over
30	the whole API tree: the content-hash `i18n-cache/` was fully stale as of this work (0/598 hits), so
31	it means ~598 sequential `claude -p` calls (hours). `check-locale-parity.ts` gates the build and now
32	checks guide basenames, the full `hu/api` page set vs `api`, required files, and hero-action parity.
33	
34	**i18nRouting audit (VitePress 2.0.0-alpha.18 / PR #5239):** we deliberately do NOT set a custom
35	`i18nRouting` function. Our symmetric prefix structure is exactly what VitePress's default handles —
36	its nav switchers use `useLangs({ correspondingLink: true })` (switch maps to the corresponding
37	page) and `cleanUrls: true` yields clean links. See the comment near `locales:` in config.ts. See
38	[[pantoken-architecture]].

content.text:
Done. The Hungarian sidebar labels from `formats/components` (via `@cssdoc/typedoc`) now translate.

## What was wrong

Two things had to line up, and only one was in place:

1. **The glossary didn't know the CSS section-group terms.** The sidebar labels and the matching `## …` headings in `api/css/index.md` pass through the deterministic `glossary` adapter, which had no entries for Overview, Components, Utilities, Rules, or Declarations — so they rendered in English.

2. **The translation memory had them cached as English.** A build predating any glossary entry cached each label as an English passthrough in `docs/i18n-cache/hu.api.json` (the committed cache). Even after I added the glossary terms, `translateUnits` kept serving the stale English from cache and never re-translated (the rebuild reported "0 translated").

## The fix

- Added glossary entries in [api-translation.ts](docs/scripts/api-translation.ts) — both a whole-string form (`^Overview$`) for the isolated sidebar labels and a heading-anchored form (`^# Overview$`) for the overview page headings, following the existing anchoring convention so these common words never fire inside prose.
- Evicted the five stale English keys from the committed cache and rebuilt, so they re-translate.

Result:

| English | Hungarian |
|---|---|
| Overview | Áttekintés |
| Components | Komponensek |
| Utilities | Segédosztályok |
| Rules | Szabályok |
| Declarations | Deklarációk |

Tracked changes: [api-translation.ts](docs/scripts/api-translation.ts) and [hu.api.json](docs/i18n-cache/hu.api.json). The `docs/hu/api/` tree itself is gitignored (rebuilt in CI). Locale parity and drift checks both pass.

One judgment call worth flagging: I translated **Utilities** as **Segédosztályok** ("helper/utility classes") since these are CSS utility-class files. If you'd prefer the more generic **Segédeszközök**, say so and I'll swap it.
